description: Long Islanders deserve a seat at the table to make sure our voices are heard. I am Kim Keiserman and I am committed to ensuring that our district thrives by prioritizing great public schools, a healthy environment, women’s rights and sensible gun laws while also working to ensure that Long Island is a safe, affordable, welcoming community for all.
